title: Methali: (Theme 5: Kukabiliana na umaskini)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child gives the hidden lesson of a methali on hard work and matches it to a situation with the same lesson.
contexts: a farmer in the dry season

board.say: Kazi ndogo ndogo zikiendelea, hutokea nini?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child says the lesson and tells a situation where it fits.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mchumia juani hulia kivulini. Maana yake ni nini?" Kwa nini "Anayekaa juani hulia" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Methali haisemi maana yake wazi. Mchumia juani hulia kivulini ina maana kwamba anayefanya kazi kwa bidii atapumzika na kufurahia matunda yake.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Haba na haba hujaza kibaba. Maana yake ni nini?" Kwa nini "Umoja ni nguvu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kila methali ina funzo lake. Haba na haba hujaza kibaba inafundisha kwamba kidogo kidogo hujaza.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Haba na haba hujaza ___." Kwa nini "chupa" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Methali hubaki jinsi ilivyo. Mwisho sahihi ni kibaba: haba na haba hujaza kibaba.
Chagua methali yenye funzo linalolingana na kisa.

checks.question: Maana ya "Haba na haba hujaza kibaba" ni?
